units.source_text: 大女公子回忆起父亲的遗言，想道：“确实，人生在世，难免遭逢此种意外之苦患。”

en.t: The elder princess recalled her father's last words and thought, "Indeed, in this life one cannot avoid encountering such unexpected suffering."

units.source_text: 便觉万事都可悲伤，心地黯然，眼泪跟着宇治川的水声滚滚而下。

en.t: Then everything seemed sorrowful to her; her heart grew dark, and her tears poured down along with the sound of the waters of the Uji River.
